biotools.summary: Nemacounter is a user-friendly software designed to accurately count and measure cysts from the soybean-cyst nematode (Heterodera glycines). It offers a graphical user interface for easy-to-use phenotypic screening and provides annotated images and data compilation for analysis and reporting.
